title: Déjà vu as a false positive from a familiarity detector

statements.text: Déjà vu may be a familiarity detector, whose normal function is to tag input as novel or familiar, issuing a false positive that is consumed by varied higher-level receivers. The sketch is offered as unconfirmed, to show how a phenomenal property might be located in the typical sequelae of inner states rather than in non-functional properties.

sources.quote: Suppose that there is a ‘familiarity detector’ whose normal function is to tag current perceptual input as either novel or familiar
